verdict.rationale: cubic documents a diff-review UI that can hide test files and keeps group explanations beside the diff. For checks, it runs automatic AI reviews on every PR, local `cubic review` of uncommitted changes before pushing, deeper Ultrareview passes, custom-agent rule enforcement, cross-repo checks, and issue-requirement analysis. One user reports reviews became quieter and more useful, and another says cubic contextualizes the app better than similar tools. Missing for 10: evidence of deterministic checks (tests/lint/CI status checks) or merge gating that blocks bad PRs, and independent hands-on corroboration that cubic's findings reliably catch real bugs.
